lines.t: Let your hearts burst forth with praise
Let every beat resound in your chest
To the praise of my glory
Bless the name of pure, unending love
Bless the name of mercy and grace
The name of righteousness
Bless the name of Him who bore your sins upon the tree
Kiss the Son, says YAHUAH, the Holy
Kiss Him upon His feet, kiss Him upon His hands
Put your head in His side, taste and see
Come close and kiss my wounds, which I receive, yes
Each one you gave me
Kiss me and be separated no longer
Partake of His fullness and receive of me
Awaken your hearts, rose from your slumber
Your King comes to you, He is just
He is your salvation His garment is righteousness
Have you grasped it? Hurry, lay hold on it
He is my heart, says the Father
Press your ear against my chest and listen to the sound of my love
Every beat of my mercy, feel the embrace of my arms
Strong and gentle, I am your Father
Your heart's one embrace, my children
Have you heard, have you truly considered
The desire of ages is come
Therefore sing, sing for me
The bridegroom approaches
He is my heart, says the Father
Press your ear against my chest and listen to the sound of my love
Every beat of my mercy
Feel the embrace of my arms
Strong and gentle
Therefore sing
Sing for me
The bridegroom approaches
